card.name: Small words before world regions or groups
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, in, and, the, a comma) in news or policy prose, right before a region, country group or political bloc is named, such as the developing world, the South, the Muslim world or Europe.

modes.description: The word 'of' or 'in' comes just before a world region or country group.

card.writes: It nudges the model toward naming geographic or political regions and groups next, such as Europe, the Midwest or Arabic-world terms.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in political or world-affairs writing when a region or bloc is about to be named.
